settings.heading: Hire Nestt Limited
settings.content: Hire Nestt Limited is a professional resume writing and career services company, founded by Muhammad Zohaib to give job seekers documents that hold up under real scrutiny — from applicant tracking systems, from recruiters, and from the candidate's own confidence walking into an interview. We work with clients across industries and career stages, worldwide.

settings.heading: Give Every Client a Fair Shot at Being Seen
settings.text: Qualified people get filtered out every day — not because they lack the experience, but because their resume was never built to communicate it clearly to a screening system or a recruiter skimming for 10 seconds. Our mission is straightforward: remove that gap, so the decision comes down to your actual qualifications.

settings.heading: Career Materials That Meet a Premium Standard
settings.text: We want Hire Nestt to be recognized for the same qualities we build into every resume: precision, clarity, and no wasted effort. As the hiring process becomes more automated, we intend to stay ahead of how ATS systems and recruiter search actually work — not just follow generic templates.

settings.title: Precision
settings.text: Every document is built around specific, verifiable achievements — not filler language or generic claims.

settings.title: Confidentiality
settings.text: Your career history and personal details are handled with strict privacy, never shared or sold.

settings.title: Honesty
settings.text: We never promise interviews or job offers — only professionally written, optimized materials.

settings.title: Reliability
settings.text: Clear, stated delivery windows for every package, honored consistently.

settings.heading: Why Hire Nestt Limited
settings.content: We believe a resume's job is to get you an interview — nothing more, nothing less — and that it should do that job as efficiently as possible. That means no padding, no generic objective statements, and no formatting that looks good until it hits an ATS parser. Every package is built to give you materials that work in the systems employers actually use, written by people who treat your career change as seriously as you do.

settings.heading: Let's Build Your Next Chapter
settings.text: Explore our packages and find the right fit for where you are in your career.
